package fixture

import "fmt"

// The flagged shape: the verb sits inside the string's quotes.
func bad(sha string) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf(`{"commit":{"url":"https://api.github.com/commits/%s"}}`, sha)
}

// Not flagged: %q supplies and escapes its own quotes.
func okQuoted(sha string) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf(`{"commit":{"sha":%q}}`, sha)
}

// Not flagged: a non-string slot.
func okRaw(n int, conclusion string) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf(`{"number":%d,"conclusion":%s}`, n, conclusion)
}

// Not flagged: a percent escape in a URL is not a verb.
func okPercentEscape() string {
	return `{"url":"https://example.com/a%20b"}`
}
